lines.text: How did an army with machine guns lose a war… to birds?
Vik bets his favourite hat the birds never stood a chance.
But twenty thousand emus were eating farms bare, so the army sent three soldiers and two machine guns.
On day one, farmers herded the birds toward the guns, but the emus split into little groups and ran out of range.
So the soldiers set a trap at a water hole, and over a thousand emus walked straight toward it.
The gunners waited until the birds were close… and the gun jammed after just twelve.
So they bolted a machine gun onto a truck, but the emus outran it at nearly fifty kilometres an hour, and the ground was so bumpy nobody could aim.
After a week, the soldiers pulled out.
That's when Gus rolls a bowling ball at a tight pack of marbles. Strike.
Then he scatters them across the floor, and the ball hits just one.
You see, a machine gun only wins against a crowd, and the emus refused to be a crowd.
And Vik's hat? An emu's wearing it.
So next time someone says birds can't win a war, ask them…
